name: Close
summary: A Close CRM organization: leads, contacts, opportunities, activities and tasks, advanced-filter search, and activity and pipeline reports.

api_key.description: a Close API key (Settings > Developer > API Keys); it acts as its user in one organization

notes: Ids carry a type prefix: lead_, cont_, oppo_, user_, orga_, stat_, save_.
List calls page with _limit and _skip; advanced-filter search pages with a cursor that expires after 30 seconds. Custom field values appear as custom.cf_... keys.

Rate limits are per endpoint group, per API key, with an organization limit three times higher. On 429 wait the rate_reset seconds the answer gives; the RateLimit header shows limit, remaining and reset.
Money values (opportunity value, revenue) are in cents.

endpoints.name: Get the key's user
endpoints.summary: The API key's user with their id and organization ids.

endpoints.name: List leads
endpoints.summary: Leads (companies) the key can see, most recently updated first.

_limit.description: Results per page, up to 200; 100 when omitted.

_skip.description: Results to skip, for paging (at most 250,000; 35,000 for some organizations).

_fields.description: Fields to return, comma separated; _all adds optional ones such as primary_email.

notes: Comes from the search index, so very recent changes may be missing. To filter, use close-crm.search.

endpoints.name: Get a lead
endpoints.summary: One lead with its contacts, opportunities, tasks and custom fields.

_fields.description: Fields to return, comma separated; _all adds optional ones such as primary_email.

endpoints.name: List contacts
endpoints.summary: Contacts, newest first, for the organization or one lead.

_limit.description: Results per page, up to 1000; 100 when omitted.

_skip.description: Results to skip, for paging (at most 15,000).

lead_id.description: Only contacts on this lead. Required when the key's user lacks the View All Leads permission.

endpoints.name: List opportunities
endpoints.summary: Deals filtered by owner, status, value period and dates, with totals across all matches.

_limit.description: Results per page; 100 when omitted, at most 250 with an API key.

_skip.description: Results to skip, for paging (at most 250,000).

user_id.description: Only opportunities owned by this user or group id.

status_type.description: Only statuses of this type: active, won or lost.

date_won__gte.description: Won on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

date_won__lte.description: Won on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

date_created__gte.description: Created at or after this time; ISO 8601 date or time; no offset means UTC.

date_created__lte.description: Created at or before this time; ISO 8601 date or time; no offset means UTC.

date_updated__gte.description: Updated at or after this time; ISO 8601 date or time; no offset means UTC.

lead_saved_search_id.description: Only opportunities on leads in this lead Smart View (save_...).

is_stalled.description: true for stalled opportunities only, false for the others.

_order_by.description: date_won, date_updated, date_created, confidence, user_name, value, annualized_value or annualized_expected_value; prefix - for descending.

_group_by.description: Group by user_id, date_won__week, date_won__month, date_won__quarter or date_won__year; data then holds groups.

notes: Values are in cents. The answer also carries totals over every match (total_results, total_value_one_time, total_value_monthly, total_value_annual...).

endpoints.name: List activities
endpoints.summary: Calls, emails, notes, meetings, SMS and status changes, by lead, contact, user, type or date.

_limit.description: Results per page, up to 100; 100 when omitted.

_skip.description: Results to skip, for paging (at most 250,000).

_type.description: Activity types, comma separated, e.g. Call, Email, Note, Meeting, SMS, LeadStatusChange.

date_created__gte.description: Created at or after this time.

date_created__lte.description: Created at or before this time.

activity_at__gte.description: Happened at or after this time.

activity_at__lte.description: Happened at or before this time.

notes: Some filters (user_id, contact_id, several types) only work together with a single lead_id.

endpoints.name: List tasks
endpoints.summary: Tasks and inbox items, filtered by assignee, lead, completion, type or due date.

_limit.description: Results per page, up to 1000; 100 when omitted.

assigned_to.description: Only tasks assigned to this user id.

is_complete.description: true for completed, false for open tasks.

_type.description: Task type; lead (tasks on a lead) when omitted, all for every inbox item.

view.description: inbox (open, due by today), future (open, due later) or archive (completed).

date__gte.description: Due on or after this date or time; ISO 8601 date or time; no offset means UTC.

date__lte.description: Due on or before this date or time; ISO 8601 date or time; no offset means UTC.

_order_by.description: date, due_date, date_created or date_updated; prefix - for descending. -date_created when omitted.

endpoints.name: Search with advanced filters
endpoints.summary: Leads, contacts, opportunities, activities or tasks matching a filter tree, the query language behind Smart Views.

query.description: The filter tree: an and query holding an object_type query and field_condition queries.

_fields.description: Fields to return per object type, e.g. {"lead": ["id", "display_name"]}. Without it only ids come back.

cursor.description: The cursor from the previous page; it expires after 30 seconds.

sort.description: Sort fields; sort by something stable such as date_created when paging.

include_counts.description: Add the number of matches as count.

results_limit.description: Most results across all pages; 0 with include_counts only counts.

notes: A POST that only searches; it changes no data.
Field names and conditions are listed on the Advanced Filtering Fields page; custom fields are custom.cf_...

endpoints.name: Get an activity report
endpoints.summary: Calls, emails, meetings and other activity metrics per period (overview) or per user (comparison).

type.description: overview (per time period) or comparison (per user).

datetime_range.description: {"start": ISO time, "end": ISO time}. Give this or relative_range.

users.description: User ids to limit the report to.

notes: A POST that only reads a report.
Durations are in seconds and revenue in cents.

endpoints.name: List activity report metrics
endpoints.summary: The metric names an activity report accepts.

endpoints.name: Get the opportunity status report
endpoints.summary: Per status: opportunities at the start and end of a period, and the moves in and out, overall or for a date range.

date_start.description: Start of the period; overall when the range is omitted.

query.description: A search query limiting the opportunities; not with smart_view_id.

smart_view_id.description: A Smart View limiting the opportunities; not with query.

endpoints.name: List pipelines
endpoints.summary: Every opportunity pipeline with its ordered statuses.
